Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner initially misidentified the song tied to the February 17, 2017 country radio date as “Seein’ Red” instead of the correct “Small Town Boy.” This wrong assumption set the search down the wrong path and led to chasing an incorrect album release timeline (e.g., February 24, 2017), despite WebSurfer results indicating “Seein’ Red” was added to radio in July 2016 and Billboard snippets implying the album “Current Mood” released in September 2017.
